jurisdictions.stalenessNote: ABCEats is the public UI over this dataset; pull the dataset directly.

jurisdictions.dataSource: Bergen County DHS Consumer Health + NWBRHC + Municipality OPRA
jurisdictions.accessMethod: Local Health Dept / OPRA / 人工导入
jurisdictions.mainTargets: 咖啡馆、重点品牌、甲方NJ实体
jurisdictions.stalenessNote: No statewide/online DB (confirmed). OPRA request per municipality (~10 business days). NJ special handling: route by municipality; never record missing data as 'no inspection'. Paramus (requested in #44) is the same: borough OPRA records request only (paramusborough.gov/178/Records-Request-OPRA) — no online data.

jurisdictions.dataSource: Newark Health Inspection Lookup + Food & Drug Bureau
jurisdictions.accessMethod: 查询页 / 浏览器自动化 / 人工复核
jurisdictions.mainTargets: 咖啡馆、重点品牌、甲方门店
jurisdictions.stalenessNote: Online lookup backend is JS/CAPTCHA-gated and unverified — prefer manual/OPRA via the Food & Drug Bureau; do NOT bypass bot-detection.

jurisdictions.dataSource: LA County Dept. of Public Health, Environmental Health (ArcGIS Hub)
jurisdictions.mainTargets: 咖啡馆、饮品店、重点品牌
jurisdictions.stalenessNote: Collector pending (batch 2): County ArcGIS Hub CSVs — inspections item 19b6607ac82c4512b10811870975dbdc (~24 MB) + violations item 5eaea9f89b7549ee841da7617d3a9cba (~40 MB), cp1252, rolling 3-yr window; score 0–100 (higher = better) + grade A/B/C. Excludes Pasadena / Long Beach / Vernon (own health depts). Do NOT use data.lacity.org/29fd-3paw (frozen 2018) or the old Restaurant_Inspection_Grades layer (stale).

jurisdictions.dataSource: SF DPH via DataSF — Health Inspection Scores 2024–present (Socrata tvy3-wexg)
jurisdictions.mainTargets: 重点品牌竞品对标（Blue Bottle 主场）
jurisdictions.stalenessNote: Live successor to the LIVES feed pyih-qa8i (frozen at 2019-11-28; its 2019 café/brand rows stay as intake history). ~1 row per inspection — dedupe permit+date+type (~6% repeat rows); placard Pass / Conditional Pass / Closure, no numeric score, no zip. The inspections.myhealthdepartment.com SF portal 403s non-browser clients and is not needed (same inspections).

jurisdictions.dataSource: Analyze Boston (CKAN) Food Establishment Inspections + Mayor's Food Court
jurisdictions.mainTargets: 咖啡馆、重点品牌、甲方门店

jurisdictions.dataSource: Cambridge Open Data — Sanitary Inspections (Socrata ryb9-qzmw)
jurisdictions.accessMethod: Open Data API / 批量抓取
jurisdictions.stalenessNote: Use ryb9-qzmw (the widely-cited mh73-gjid id is dead/404). One row per cited violation, grouped by case id; NO pass/fail, score or grade (result N/A); severity = (P)/(Pf)/(C) marker in code_description; case_open_date null on ~19% of rows (fall back to case_closed_date / issue_date).

jurisdictions.dataSource: DC Health Food Establishment Inspection Reports (HealthSpace)
jurisdictions.accessMethod: 查询页 / PDF / HTML 报告
jurisdictions.stalenessNote: Collector pending (batch 3): no open dataset, but the site is server-rendered — 36 alphabetical listing pages (?a=inspections&alpha=A…Z, 0-9) + per-inspection report pages, plain GET, no JS/CAPTCHA. Pass/fail with Priority / Priority Foundation / Core counts, no grade or score. Report pages show staff names/emails — never store them.

jurisdictions.dataSource: FDACS Food Permit Center — Food Establishment Inspection Reports
jurisdictions.accessMethod: 查询页 / 表单搜索 (manual / public-records)
jurisdictions.stalenessNote: fdacs.gov robots.txt is default-deny and disallows /search — do NOT scrape. Use the UI manually or a public-records request. (Restaurants proper are DBPR, out of scope.)

jurisdictions.dataSource: Chicago Dept. of Public Health — Food Inspections (Socrata 4ijn-s7e5)
jurisdictions.mainTargets: 重点品牌竞品对标（无瑞幸门店）
jurisdictions.stalenessNote: Daily refresh. 1 row per inspection; violations in one ' | '-separated field (inspector comments dropped). Result Pass / Pass w/ Conditions / Fail, no score. Brand sometimes only in aka_name (franchisee dba).

jurisdictions.dataSource: Santa Clara County DEH — businesses vuw7-jmjk / inspections 2u2d-8jej / violations wkaa-4ccv (Socrata)
jurisdictions.accessMethod: Open Data API（采集器内三表关联）
jurisdictions.mainTargets: 重点品牌竞品对标（无瑞幸门店）
jurisdictions.stalenessNote: San Jose & Palo Alto. Placard G/Y/R + score 0–100 (higher = better, stored as text). Rolling ~2-yr window, refreshed ~monthly. Source column is misspelled 'inpsection_id'.

jurisdictions.dataSource: Alameda County Environmental Health — Food Safety Program inspection results
jurisdictions.mainTargets: 重点品牌竞品对标（无瑞幸门店）
jurisdictions.stalenessNote: Not online: the county is migrating its inspection software and asks the public to phone; data.acgov.org has no food-inspection dataset (checked 2026-11-02). Re-check after the migration.

jurisdictions.dataSource: San Mateo County Environmental Health — MyEHS portal (Salesforce)
jurisdictions.mainTargets: 重点品牌竞品对标（无瑞幸门店）
jurisdictions.stalenessNote: JavaScript-only Salesforce Experience Cloud app — no server-rendered data or public API; data.smcgov.org has no food dataset (checked 2026-11-02). Manual lookup only.

jurisdictions.dataSource: Pasadena Public Health — Health Inspection Reports (JSON behind the search page)
jurisdictions.accessMethod: 查询页 JSON（关键词搜索）
jurisdictions.mainTargets: 重点品牌竞品对标（无瑞幸门店）
jurisdictions.stalenessNote: Collector pending (batch 3): POST /Inspection/SearchPermits + /Inspection/GetInspections (current system; violations only in PDF) and legacy /SearchEnvisionPermits + /GetEnvisionInspections (2014–2025-11, score 0–100 + violations). Keyword search only. Own health dept — not in LA County data.

jurisdictions.dataSource: San Diego County DEHQ — sdfoodinfo.org (JSON behind the search page)
jurisdictions.mainTargets: 重点品牌竞品对标（无瑞幸门店）
jurisdictions.stalenessNote: Collector pending (batch 3): POST name=<term> returns business → inspections → violations; score 0–100 + grade A/B/C on routine inspections. Whole-word search — query 'MCDONALDS' etc. and filter by name.

jurisdictions.dataSource: Southern Nevada Health District — nightly restaurant data ZIP
jurisdictions.mainTargets: 重点品牌竞品对标（无瑞幸门店）
jurisdictions.stalenessNote: Collector pending (batch 2): ~9 MB ZIP rebuilt nightly; inspections (2020-09+) join establishments by permit_number and violations by a comma ID list. Demerits (lower = better) + grade A/B/C/X. Establishments file has latitude/longitude swapped.

jurisdictions.dataSource: Fairfax County Health Dept. — Permitted Food Establishments (ArcGIS FeatureServer)
jurisdictions.mainTargets: 重点品牌竞品对标（无瑞幸门店）（Tysons）
jurisdictions.stalenessNote: Outcome only (Passed / Partial Pass / Failed / Failed - Self Closed) — no score or violation detail in the feed; each row links its Accela report. Rolling ~2-yr window; max 2,000 records per query.
